briefing: NASDAQ +0.7% and S&P 500 +0.6% show a mild risk-on tone, and three candidates (TEM, COMP, TSLA) cleared the full four-signal confirmation bar (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge) that past reviews flagged as true institutional buying. With 3 open slots and $1289 in cash well above the deployment threshold, we filled all three slots with these fully-confirmed names rather than letting cash sit idle; existing positions are held unchanged.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for multiple technical signals — like RSI in a healthy bullish range, a MACD bullish crossover, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — to all line up before buying, rather than acting on just one signal. When several signals agree, it's a stronger sign that real buyers (not just random short-term noise) are driving the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在買入前等待多個技術訊號同時出現,例如RSI處於健康的上升區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價高於移動平均線,以及成交量放大,而不是僅憑單一訊號就進場。當多個訊號同時成立時,代表背後有真實買盤支撐,而非短期隨機波動。

market_education.summary_en: Equity markets drifted modestly higher today, with the NASDAQ up 0.7% and the S&P 500 up 0.6%, a continuation of the recent mild uptrend rather than a sharp catalyst-driven move. Volume surges in several growth and small-cap names (TEM, COMP, TSLA) suggest institutional buyers are rotating back into momentum stocks rather than large index-wide news driving the tape. Without a single dominant headline today, the move looks more like broad-based accumulation than a reaction to a specific event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日股市溫和上揚,納斯達克指數上升0.7%,標普500指數上升0.6%,延續近期的小幅升勢,並非由單一重大消息帶動。多隻成長股及中小型股(如TEM、COMP、TSLA)出現成交量放大,顯示機構資金正重新回流至具動能的個股,而非整體指數受單一新聞刺激。今日缺乏明顯的主導消息,這波走勢更像是廣泛的資金累積,而非對特定事件的反應。
